messages.subject: Print in a row results from DT
parts:
Hi

In my application I enter a name and a year and return filtered data-set in screen.
Code from application server.R file is listed below:

# Get raw data
getTable <- function(df, reaction){
  nameSearch = capitalize(tolower(reaction$nameSearch))
  new_df <- subset(df, grepl(nameSearch, Name))
  year <- reaction$year
  indices <- which((new_df$Year >= year[1] & new_df$Year <= year[2]))
  new_df <- new_df[indices,-1]
  new_df$region <- toupper(new_df$region)
  colnames(new_df) <- c("City", "Gender", "Year", "Name", "Frequency")
  return(new_df)
}

I need to print in a label below the table the sum of all frequencies for the searched name

I mean if I search for John and table returned is :

City                  Gender            Year             Name     Frequency

LA                        M                  2012             John        5
Chicago               M                  2012             John        10
New York             M                  2012             John        12


I need some label with text: "There are 27 people with name John for 2012" under the table to be shown

Please help in this task

Regards
